lesson: When a patchset carries an older whole-file queuebash payload, compare it against the current base before copying. For 0.18.116, Bob19 granular AI broker health-event staging was useful, but its queuebash.sh would have downgraded 0.18.115 cluster materialisation; merge only the contract harness delta and preserve newer runtime work. Bob26 VCS tenant coverage applies cleanly as additive VCS contract/classes/tests.
